brief: Rebalance a plan after an expense increases while keeping its totals consistent.

en-US.scenario: Fictional US-dollar examples for "Rebalance after a change"; illustrative amounts, not current prices or product offers. No assumption of salary, bank ownership or spare income.

es-MX.scenario: Ejemplos ficticios en pesos mexicanos para "Reequilibra después de un cambio"; montos ilustrativos, no precios vigentes ni ofertas. No se supone nómina, cuenta bancaria ni dinero sobrante.

pt-BR.scenario: Exemplos fictícios em reais para "Reequilibre após uma mudança"; valores ilustrativos, não preços atuais nem ofertas. Sem supor salário, conta bancária ou dinheiro sobrando.

objective.observable_action: Rebalance a plan after an expense increases while keeping its totals consistent.
objective.success_criterion: Complete the fresh-context transfer using only its visible information.

instruction.relevance: A changed cost must change the total or another feasible allocation.
instruction.misconception: Increasing one allocation while leaving the total and every other allocation unchanged.
instruction.numeracy_support: The worked examples introduce the required operation; every assessed task retains its own amounts and assumptions.

evidence.reasoning: If a required cost rises, update the total. Reduce another feasible allocation or show the remaining gap.
Without another change, the added cost creates a gap.
An adjustment must be feasible and protect the stated necessity.
A plan edit cannot reverse an actual completed payment.

delayed_retrieval.fresh_context: Retrieve this competence in the declared later course reviews and through the existing shared review system.
